method: Original private ActionScript Ray class and root callback equations in independent VM; MovieClip rendering stubbed; sparse AS2 array holes preserved for equation search and filtered only for snapshot output

results.scope: Independent original Ray class and root runthis/goRay; parallel and mean-random fan, each added input min/default/max, 32 seeded source-range random conditions, all 11 cavity focal values. First 100 callbacks: every ray coordinate/angle/out, optical component and visible segment endpoint. Random stream is supplied only in private reference. Not every continuous input product or event history.
